images.name: duties
images.title: A real estate team assistant, *duty by duty*
rows: Sends the property facts in minutes, asks the intake questions and books the agent.
Requests, confirms and reschedules showings, and collects feedback on listings.
Builds the timeline from the contract, reminds every party and chases documents.
Books photos and signs, drafts the description and open house reminders for the agent.
Keeps anniversaries and check-ins going from the CRM.
Writes up the question with its context. A licensed agent answers.

images.name: saturday
images.title: A Saturday for the *AI team assistant*
rows: Reminds a buyer, their lender and the listing agent that the inspection period ends Monday at 5 pm.
A portal lead asks about a three-bedroom. It sends the facts, asks the intake questions and books a showing.
A listing agent declines the 2 pm showing. It moves the buyer's tour and resends the route.
A seller asks whether they should drop the price. It writes up the question with this week's feedback.
Texts all 14 open house sign-ins with the property details and books one second showing.
A buyer under contract asks if they can back out after the appraisal. It sends the question to their agent.
A new lead asks about a listing. It replies in minutes and books a call with the agent on rotation for Sunday.
